reuse.why: All providers share the new link guard and reuse findOrCreateBank and syncAccount, but Fintegra copies existing linking and download workflows and replacement duplicates unlink state clearing.

duplication.why: The diff adds three duplicated blocks: the provider linking workflow, transaction downloader, and local unlink field reset.

placement.why: Changes follow existing account, sync, configuration, and model layers, although unlink mutations are awkwardly placed inside an assertion helper.

scope.why: Edits are confined to the requested linking rules, Fintegra integration, required provider mappings, and release notes.

maintainability.why: Centralized link rules help maintenance, but copied provider workflows and a validation helper that also unlinks accounts obscure responsibilities and increase future editing costs.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts: assertBankAccountNotLinked reproduces unlinkAccount's local state reset; extract that operation for both callers while keeping provider removal separate.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions reproduce the Pluggy.ai workflows with provider names, identifiers, and endpoint constants substituted.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink, closed-target rejection, and conditional unlink mutations, expanding an assertion into a state-changing operation; all six provider linking handlers use it.
